_README: MAINNET authority assignment for the Dominion SILV launch. Confirmed by Thomas 2026-07-26.
This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the mainnet deploy ceremony. Every one of
these decisions is IRREVERSIBLE or expensive to undo, so they are recorded here rather
than typed at a terminal. Verify with: scripts/verify-mainnet-authorities.ts
These are PUBLIC KEYS. Publishing them is safe (they are on-chain regardless) and
desirable: anyone can check that the deployed program's authorities match what was
announced. No secret material belongs in this file, ever.

ops_admin.role: config.admin. Day-to-day operations: premint, param setters, proposing timelocked actions.
ops_admin.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)
ops_admin.verified_onchain: 2026-07-26: exists on mainnet, 0.100251 SOL, System-owned, OFF-CURVE
ops_admin.notes: The hottest key: touched on every operational action. Correctly separated from the upgrade authority.

upgrade_authority.role: BPF loader upgrade authority. Can replace the program with arbitrary code, which overrides EVERY in-program safeguard. The ultimate trust root.
upgrade_authority.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)
upgrade_authority.verified_onchain: 2026-07-26: exists on mainnet, 0.001 SOL, System-owned, OFF-CURVE
upgrade_authority.notes: SHARES A KEY with compliance and guardian. See risk_accepted.upgrade_equals_compliance.

compliance.role: SILV mint freeze_authority AND Token-2022 permanent delegate. Can freeze/thaw any holder and transfer or burn any holder's tokens. Set at MINT CREATION and permanent.
compliance.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)
compliance.notes: Written into config.freeze_authority_expected and config.permanent_delegate_expected at initialize, and re-asserted on EVERY user instruction. If this vault is ever lost below threshold, freeze and seize are PERMANENTLY unrecoverable: not even the upgrade authority can restore an external SPL authority.

guardian.role: Guardian veto: pause, cancel_timelocked_action, cancel_admin_transfer during a delay window.
guardian.kind: off-curve (PDA, consistent with a Squads vault)
guardian.notes: Distinct from ops_admin, which is what matters for the code: add_guardian refuses config.admin and GuardianAccount::may_act refuses a guardian that IS the admin. Both pass with this assignment. More guardians to be added shortly (Thomas, 2026-07-26); MIN_ACTIVE_GUARDIANS is 1 and max_guardian_count defaults to 3.

inventory_wallet.role: config.inventory_wallet. Destination of admin_premint. Holds the pre-minted SILV before it is sent to the DEX pool.
inventory_wallet.kind: ON-CURVE (a plain single-signer wallet, NOT a multisig)
inventory_wallet.verified_onchain: 2026-07-26: exists on mainnet, 0.119654603 SOL, System-owned, ON-CURVE
inventory_wallet.notes: Deliberately a hot wallet so inventory can be moved to the pool without a multisig round trip. It will hold the ENTIRE pre-minted supply, so its private key is as valuable as the float. Consider a Squads vault once the pool is seeded and inventory stops moving.

deployer.role: Pays for the mainnet deploy and signs initialize. MUST be the upgrade authority at initialize time (audit DOM-001 binds them), so either deploy from the upgrade Squads vault or transfer the upgrade authority to it AFTER initialize.
deployer.verified_onchain: 2026-07-26: DOES NOT EXIST on mainnet (AccountNotFound, zero balance)
deployer.notes: BLOCKER: needs funding before any mainnet deploy. A ~1.05 MB program needs about 7.5 SOL of rent, plus the buffer at peak. Budget 9 SOL.

upgrade_equals_compliance.what: upgrade_authority and compliance are the SAME vault (FqFNX...), and it is also the guardian.
upgrade_equals_compliance.why_it_matters: SolidProof TrustNet MEDIUM #1 is precisely 'these must be split across separate multisigs'. A compromise of FqFNX can replace the program with arbitrary code AND freeze or seize any holder's balance. That is the complete-takeover scenario the audit named, lacking only the ops_admin role, which an arbitrary upgrade can grant itself anyway.
upgrade_equals_compliance.what_it_DOES_still_defend: The more likely compromise. ops_admin is the hot, frequently-signed key, and it is genuinely separate: if it falls, FqFNX can veto its timelocked actions as guardian and repair the program as upgrade authority.
upgrade_equals_compliance.recommendation: Separate upgrade_authority from compliance before material value accrues. Compliance is a WARM key (it gets exercised in response to legal orders); an upgrade authority should be COLD, used rarely, and ideally renounced once the code is final. A third vault, or renouncing upgradeability post-launch, closes this.
upgrade_equals_compliance.status: ACCEPTED for launch by Thomas 2026-07-26, with the split tracked as a follow-up.
